assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. New production material FILL texture atlas for the original game Rivenbloom, matching the painted wood/stone/rootglass materials of this project's supplied terrain strips. Create an OPAQUE 1536x1024 canvas in strict 3columns x2rows of512x512 cells. Each cell is completely filled EDGE TO EDGE with its material, no gaps or margins, no scenery, no top surface bevel, no platforms, no text/grid/borders/lighting halos. Flat FRONT FACES of terrain interiors, NOT bird's-eye surfaces. Five quiet painterly material textures for filling tall walls beneath separate illustrated platform caps. Row1col1: dark warm aged timber beams, broad vertical wood grain, gentle copper nail marks, shadowed chestnut values; row1col2: dark storm-teal damp earth/slate beneath forest moss, sparse curving roots and broad dark stone shapes; row1col3: dark ink-violet cave slate with sparse pale chalk fissures and tiny dim mint mineral flecks. Row2col1: subdued storm-teal rootglass/ivory archive wall, large QUIET stone panels with slender curved pale rootglass veins and aged copper inlay; row2col2: midnight plum slate sanctuary wall, sparse dark copper mineral cracks and broad chalky stone facets. Row2col3: unused very quiet midnight-plum stone texture. Each cell must seamlessly tile horizontally AND vertically: identical material value at opposing edges, no bright borders, no horizon, no dramatic lighting. Deliberately restrained contrast and large painted colour shapes, low detail, no thin horizontal stripes, no busy repeating arches, no strong vertical streaks. Painterly vellum and material-specific wood/stone texture, same original palette as reference. These are COMPLETE square textures, not isolated floating props or strips. Do not copy outside game artwork.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production side-view NPC sprite sheet for original game Rivenbloom. Image 1 is the canonical PORTRAIT IDENTITY reference; image 2 is a supporting world-sprite style reference whose first two character identities are incorrect. Create exactly three isolated full-body side-view standing figures facing RIGHT, evenly placed in three equal columns on a landscape 1536x1024 transparent canvas, feet all at y=930 with generous transparent padding; no scenery, cast shadows, glow, grid or text. Left: Sela Quill MATCH portrait in row1 column2 of image1: elderly woman, clearly silver-white long braid, round copper spectacles, lined face, cream blouse, moss-green shawl and long teal skirt, holds rolled survey chart. Center: Orin Fen MATCH portrait row1 col3: broad stocky middle-aged craftsman with rust-red hair and LARGE red beard, copper goggles on brow, rolled cream sleeves, brown leather apron, heavy boots, small hammer at hip. Right: Piri Moss MATCH portrait row1 col4: small youthful round-faced child with dark curly brown hair, wide moss-green leafy hat, cream tunic, moss cloak, amber seed-lantern in hand. Relative heights elderly woman 780px, broad craftsman 810px, child 650px; ground common. Preserve these project's identities and warm painterly vellum/carved wood art style. Optimize at 100-120px runtime height: broad quiet colour shapes, restrained interior detail, crisp continuous silhouettes, cream/copper/moss/plum palette, no tangled foliage all over costume. Real fully transparent alpha outside figures, no painted background, no halo. Original project characters only; no references to other games.

assets.originalPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation supplement for original Rivenbloom heroine Mara Vey. Reference image is the project's original Mara: preserve her visible brunette face, braided hair, asymmetrical moss-green cloak, long teal scarf, cream tunic, plum trousers, copper bracers, brown boots, folding leaf-crescent surveyor blade. Create exactly EIGHT isolated full-body poses in strict FOUR columns TWO rows on 1536x1024 canvas; each cell384x512, identical character scale, feet/common ground line at local y=460, generous empty gutters. All poses face RIGHT, no text/grid/scenery/shadows. Top row four consecutive RUN cycle poses: (1) right foot forward heel strike with left leg extended behind, (2) weight-bearing bent front leg with rear knee passing, (3) opposite left foot forward full stride with right leg behind, (4) weight-bearing opposite leg passing. Second row: (5) airborne run stride one with BOTH feet off ground and legs clearly extended front/back, (6) airborne opposite run stride with feet off ground and reversed leg positions, (7) DEATH lying completely horizontal on ground, cloak folded, blade at rest, eyes closed, clearly different from standing hurt; (8) INTERACT standing reaching forward with empty right hand, blade lowered in other hand. Run cycle silhouettes must be visibly distinct, coherent anatomically and same body size; scarf trails behind all running poses. Keep details quiet: broad cloak/tunic shapes, sharply separated limbs, readable at 110px height. Painterly vellum/ink style exactly matching reference. True fully transparent alpha background; do not paint coloured backgrounds or aura, no magic effects, no motion blur, no framing. Original project identity only.
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix ONLY the production atlas packing of this Rivenbloom Mara sprite supplement. Preserve heroine identity, painterly style, outfits, exactly eight pose meanings and two rows/four columns. Output1536x1024, uniform384x512 cells. Scale every standing/running figure slightly smaller so ALL artwork including scarf/blade fits INSIDE each cell x=24..360 and y=60..466, no overlapping neighbour cells. Main human head/body scale identical in all run/interaction poses. Top row columns1..4 consecutive visibly distinct alternating-leg run poses (full right stride, right passing, full left stride, left passing); bottom row cols1..2 two opposite airborne running strides. Bottom row col3 death must fit ENTIRELY within x=792..1128,y=832..978, lying horizontally eyes closed with blade flat and cloak resting, fully isolated from adjacent cell. Bottom row col4 reaching interaction pose. There must be a truly empty transparent gutter on ALL four boundaries of EVERY cell. Do not copy pixels from adjacent poses into any cell. Strong clean alpha silhouette and broad quiet shading, no added glow/background/scenery/text/grid. Genuine alpha transparency, not a painted brown background. Keep original project heroine only.

Use case: style-transfer. Production enemy animation atlas for original game Rivenbloom. Image is project's OWN original enemy sheet, sole design reference. Redraw these same seven identities with much simpler broad painted shapes, quiet surfaces, crisp continuous contours, strongly different silhouettes, and cream face/weapon/core accents readable at 100px tall. Exactly SIX columns SEVEN rows on a portrait transparent 1536x1792 canvas (cells256x256), no text/grid/borders. Every figure isolated inside its cell with at least 12px padding, never bleed into neighbours. Row1 Briar Scrapper: low moss quadruped, 4 separated sturdy twig limbs, large pale ceramic animal mask; broad green moss back with sparse twigs. Row2 Duskwing: clearly wide lavender/plum moth-bat wings with pale cream membrane, small dark body, hanging copper seedhooks. Row3 Spore Scribe: recognisable wide ivory shelf-fungus cap, purple/teal robe-like stalk body, bent reed focus, no twig fur. Row4 Barkbound: tall slab-like brown husk with large broad door bark shield, one bright mint exposed core; only a few clean wood fissures. Row5 Rootlurker: S-shaped single broad teal-green ribbon root, distinct bell-jaw ivory/coral mouth, no shaggy foliage. Row6 Thorn Sentinel: slender copper armoured vine guardian, large circular thorn halo, long cream/mint spear; clear limbs. Row7 Pallid Cantor: pale towering porcelain-throated bird effigy, large broad cream rootglass wing fans and four copper chimes, mint heart, preserve bird face facing LEFT. All other rows face RIGHT. Six columns per row are exact poses: 1 calm idle, 2 distinct moving pose, 3 anticipatory windup crouched or weapon pulled back with small coral edge accent, 4 active lunge/dive/swing visibly extended forward (fit entire pose within cell), 5 recoiling hurt pose, 6 collapsed defeat pose on floor. Consistent scale WITHIN row; foot baseline local y=236 for grounded rows; wings fixed body/pivot baseline. Threat accents coral, no huge glow or attack effects baked across cells. Hand-painted vellum with wood/copper/rootglass materials matching reference, simplified tonal grouping, never glossy 3D or emoji/flat primitives. Genuine alpha transparency outside silhouettes. No scenery, aura, motion blur, copyrighted game references.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Rivenbloom production side-view seamless terrain material atlas. The provided project's world atlas is the sole material/style reference. Create a 1536x1024 transparent sheet containing exactly FIVE wide HORIZONTAL terrain bands vertically spaced: y=40..200 village timber, y=230..390 wet forest earth, y=420..580 violet cave slate, y=610..770 ivory rootglass archive stone, y=800..960 dark choral sanctuary slate. Each band extends from left image edge to right image edge, no isolated platform islands, no scenery, NO banners, NO lanterns, NO mushrooms growing above floor, no crystals above floor. Each band is a continuous side-view cross-section with a straight crisp horizontal walkable top edge, a shallow painted top bevel and restrained irregular hanging lower contour. Thick quiet material masses, gentle carved/painted shading, sparse grain or cracks, readable at 80px tall. Left and right edges of each material band MUST seamlessly match in height, tone and shading for horizontal repeat, no obvious motif every tile. Village warm aged timber planks with copper nails and soft golden lip; forest dark teal slate/soil with narrow sage moss lip and occasional tiny trailing roots underneath; cave ink-violet stone with warm cream upper ledge, tiny moon-mint mineral flecks underneath; archive pale chalky stone, mint translucent rootglass seams underneath, aged copper inlay; sanctuary dark plum stone with a warm chalk upper ledge and occasional muted copper crack. Keep amber/mint highlights restrained. No spikes on any walkable surface, no hazards, no labels/text/grid/borders, no other-game references. Genuine alpha transparency between the five bands; preserve empty gaps and no atmospheric background. High resolution painterly vellum/wood/stone texture, broad tonal grouping.

No cave or palace. Calm inviting golden lantern light against a rainy teal woodland, generous quiet negative space behind actors.
